visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair in a braid, wearing a grey high-neck crop top and dark trousers, stands outdoors in a lush green park. She is holding a black electronic wind instrument (EWI) and begins playing it, with her fingers moving rhythmically over the keys. Above her, a musical score graphic is displayed, and a small inset video shows a cartoon penguin dancing in various settings. (2) As the performance continues, the woman remains focused on the instrument, her mouth positioned on the mouthpiece. The background remains a static urban park with trees and a paved path. Text overlays at the bottom of the screen update in real-time, showing numerical, alphabetical, and katakana notations that correspond to the notes being played. (3) The woman completes the musical phrase, maintaining her posture and grip on the instrument until the video ends. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting a clear summer day. The overall framing is a static medium shot, focusing on her upper body and the instrument.

No human voices are present. (3) The melody reaches a conclusion as the final note of the EWI is held slightly longer.
